company.name: University of Utah Hospitals and Clinics

positions.title: Informatics Pharmacist
positions.description:
-	Go-Live build and support experience for a 4+ hospital system and ancillary clinics moving to a new EHR 
-	Provide technical and workflow guidance to safety, quality, and decision-making committees for a multi-hospital teaching institution
-	Pharmacy informatics team lead for the following areas: reporting, security, workflow-engine, profiles, procedural area, and ADT
-	Developed the rounding tools and workflows for the pharmacy department 

Implementation and support of all medication and pharmacy-related software across a multi-facility system. Tasks and areas of experience include but are not limited to: 
 - Workflow Resolution: Procedural, Radiology, Anesthesia, Ambulatory Clinics
- Upgrade build & testing 
- Monthly Medi-Span loads  
- Barcode Medication Administration (BCMA) 
- Clinical Decision Support (CDS)
- Automated Dispensing Cabinets
- Medication Carousel Inventory Management 
- End-user communication
- 340B
- Residency training and project guidance

projects.title: Localize
projects.description:
Localize is a full-stack application that connects small businesses to big businesses. We're fighting gentrification by making local and deeply rooted services more visible to large enterprises. Our goal is to foster collaboration and success for both parties by giving an easy means of direct communication.
* A full-stack web application that makes it easy for large companies to source their service and product needs from local businesses.
* Wrote RESTful routes in Node.js to pull information from the Yelp API to overcome Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) errors using AJAX calls 
* Incorporated custom markers and passing of state across components in React.js and the Google Maps API
* Created a seamless user experience incorporating Yelp’s autocomplete API and Google Maps

projects.title: Enchant
projects.description: Enchant is a full-stack, single-page web application modeled after Behance. It is built with a Ruby on Rails backend, a React.js/Redux frontend, and a PostgreSQL database. Media hosting is done through Amazon Web Services (S3) and application hosting is through Heroku.
